name: Stakeholder Profile
purpose: A visual aid to understand a stakeholder’s role within a business and/or decision-making process.
whereUsed: The Stakeholder Profile is best introduced in the Problem Space during the Awareness Phase (1.3) “Frame Points of View”. It can also be useful in sub- sequent phases to communicate and reinforce the roles and motivations of key stakeholders.
why: We will gain mutual understanding of a stakeholder’s professional and business motivators driving their actions and decisions.
outcomes: Common understanding of a stakeholder’s responsibilities and motivations
Sensitivity to challenges and constraints within the role and possible implications
Clarity on how best to collaborate and build a meaningful relationship
Identify common drivers (motivations, challenges, desired results among stakeholders

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Create an initial profile for each of the key stakeholders
Document potential constraints within the business and their respective role
Understand the value and control of the stakeholder in the decision-making process
Facilitate a candid dialog to capture opportunities and risks for the stakeholder

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Review Stakeholder Profiles to keep professional and business motivators in the forefront
Take into consideration roles and dynamics among key stakeholders
Identify potential risks and generate next steps to mitigate
Facilitate candid dialogues among stakeholders to ensure alignment
